    Workbook challenge

    1. Predict where the rover will stop on the blocked path.
    2. Run the mission. Read the sensor values and explain the stop.
    3. In workbook mode, clear the obstacle and restart. In detour mode, watch the rover compare two marked routes.

    The obstacle sensor activity uses a 20 cm example. The combined rover sketch uses 30 cm. The detour is an extension with simulated branch readings on a marked track.
